The contract binds exact historical E0 pool paths and SHA-256 values; the runner revalidates each pool file SHA and task binding before any provider I/O. The Pilot reads only E0 historical pools and never inspects E1 held-out future-skill outcomes. Pool/model/renderer selection is not conditioned on learned-skill quality, mixed/rescue/effect outcome, or any E1 probe result.",
  "win_clone_identity_assessment": "PASS. Before provider calls, WIN-A and WIN-B both receive the same pre-rendered win_units list and the same win_stream StreamProjection built from the same initial skill and exact eight pools. The runner computes win_unit_bundle_sha from the canonical serialization of all win BlindedEvidenceUnit objects and hard-requires bundle stability. The arms dict maps both win_a and win_b to the identical (win_stream, win_units) tuple. Initial evidence is byte-identical (same evidence_text, same evidence_sha256) and score-identical (same source_score per pool). Hosted stochasticity may legitimately diverge later generated prompts; the runner correctly treats only the pre-provider evidence bundle as a hard invariant and does not confuse post-call stochastic divergence with treatment drift.",
  "arm_blinding_assessment": "PASS. The V3.1 blinded path uses BlindedEvidenceUnit where evidence_text is the only trajectory text placed in the first-party MindMemOS add-record messages field. build_blinded_add_record_payload constructs messages=[{role:user, content:unit.evidence_text}] with no projection, role, rollout index, path, provider, or provenance labels. All r17_* metadata fields (projection, pool_id, rollout index, trajectory SHA, acting winner SHA, acting score) are stored in the payload as provenance-only and are absent from model-visible messages. The runner additionally hard-checks that FORBIDDEN_VISIBLE_MARKERS (PROJECTION:, ROLE:, SOURCE_ROLLOUT_INDEX:, SOURCE_TRAJECTORY_SHA256:, ACTING_WINNER_INDEX:, POOL_ID:) do not appear in either WIN or MRW evidence blocks. The updater-visible score field is set to unit.source_score (the selected evidence trajectory's verifier score), not pool.acting_success; the runner asserts payload[score]==selected_score before upsert. Tests confirm score semantics and metadata non-leakage.",
  "token_parity_assessment": "PASS. ExactMatchedEvidenceBlockRenderer is used with final_block_cap_tokens=3072 under frozen tiktoken 0.11.0/cl100k_base. The renderer performs a deterministic no-padding search over source-token budgets and accepts only a pair whose final rendered UTF-8 texts re-encode to exactly the same token count. The runner hard-requires win_tokens==mrw_tokens==matched.matched_final_block_tokens for every pool. For nonmixed pools, the runner additionally requires win_block==mrw_block byte-for-byte. transcript_max_chars=100000 is explicitly checked: the runner asserts len(f'[user] {block}')<=transcript_max_chars for both WIN and MRW blocks, and the wrapper re-checks the same bound before first-party transcript construction; the limit is nonbinding because matched blocks are capped at 3072 tokens. Renderer tests confirm exact parity, no padding, frozen constants, and byte identity for identical sources.",
  "updater_semantics_assessment": "PASS. The Pilot exercises real first-party MindMemOS SkillEvolver at pinned commit 90491828726e1540442b17cd445d0308d0b8093c. The wrapper imports SkillEvolver from mindmemos.pipelines.skill.evolution, configures SkillEvolutionConfig with min_aggregate=8, max_aggregate=8 (batch=8), summary_concurrency=4, rewrite_skill=False, use_trajectory_score=True, and transcript_max_chars=100000. The adapter enforces max_parse_attempts=1 (contract), temperature=0.0 (defaulted when SkillEvolver does not pass explicit temperature), thinking=disabled, and provider_retry_limit=0 (ArkSettings max_retries=0). The runner hard-requires all receipts show provider_retry_limit==0, temperature_requested==0.0, and thinking_requested==disabled. Measurements are restricted to calls/tokens/latency/parse errors/resolved identity/budget claims/content-addressed integrity. No learned-skill quality comparison is performed or permitted.",
  "provider_budget_assessment": "PASS. ProviderBudgetLedger uses SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE to claim budget transactionally before any provider I/O. Claims are never released, even on provider error or process crash, so ambiguous calls are conservatively over-counted. Limits are 10 per arm (per_unit_limit) and 30 total (total_limit), bound to the exact contract_sha256 and authorization_sha256; any metadata drift fails closed with ProviderBudgetBindingError. The adapter calls ledger.claim(unit_id) before client.respond, and the claim is recorded in every receipt (provider_budget_claim_id, unit_call_index, total_claimed_after). The runner requires len(receipts)==len(claims)==result.provider_calls per arm and budget_snapshot.total_claimed<=30 at summary. Parse-correction attempts and poll recovery both flow through the same _respond method that claims budget first; neither can bypass the ceiling. Budget tests confirm the 11th per-unit call and 7681st global call are rejected before provider I/O.",
  "checkpoint_resume_assessment": "PASS. Each completed arm is persisted immediately: update_receipt.json and skill_post/SKILL.md are content-addressed, and the arm row is appended to checkpoints/completed_arms.jsonl with fsync. On resume, verify_completed revalidates receipt SHA, skill SHA, contract_sha256, authorization_sha256, causal_purity_mode==arm_blinded_selected_evidence, and arm_metadata_visible_in_transcript==False for every completed row. The ProviderBudgetLedger is rebound with allow_create=False if the ledger already exists, refusing to initialize missing metadata on resume. Most importantly, if an arm directory exists and contains any provider-call artifacts but the arm is absent from completed_arms.jsonl, the runner raises RuntimeError('partial ambiguous arm exists without completed manifest; do not auto-rerun') and STOPs rather than automatically rerunning that arm.",

V2 correctly refuses inheritance from the actor/evaluator runtime and binds a dedicated persistent-updater runtime. validate_updater_runtime verifies: exact venv_root is a directory; python_executable equals venv/bin/python exactly; freeze file exists and its SHA matches runtime.freeze_sha256; qualification file exists, its SHA matches runtime.qualification_sha256, and its status equals PASS_ZERO_PROVIDER_FULL_MINDMEMOS_UPDATER_RUNTIME; the qualification's venv_root, python_executable, and freeze_sha256 all match the contract; the post-lock compatibility override is present, package==tiktoken, qualified_runtime_version==0.11.0. review.arm_blinding_assessment: PASS. The V3.1 blinded path uses BlindedEvidenceUnit where evidence_text is the only trajectory text placed in the first-party MindMemOS add-record messages field. build_blinded_add_record_payload constructs messages=[{role:user, content:unit.evidence_text}] with no projection, role, rollout index, path, provider, or provenance labels. All r17_* metadata fields (projection, pool_id, rollout index, trajectory SHA, acting winner SHA, acting score) are stored in the payload as provenance-only and are absent from model-visible messages. The runner additionally hard-checks that FORBIDDEN_VISIBLE_MARKERS (PROJECTION:, ROLE:, SOURCE_ROLLOUT_INDEX:, SOURCE_TRAJECTORY_SHA256:, ACTING_WINNER_INDEX:, POOL_ID:) do not appear in either WIN or MRW evidence blocks. The updater-visible score field is set to unit.source_score (the selected evidence trajectory's verifier score), not pool.acting_success; the runner asserts payload[score]==selected_score before upsert. Tests confirm score semantics and metadata non-leakage.
review.checkpoint_resume_assessment: PASS. Each completed arm is persisted immediately: update_receipt.json and skill_post/SKILL.md are content-addressed, and the arm row is appended to checkpoints/completed_arms.jsonl with fsync. On resume, verify_completed revalidates receipt SHA, skill SHA, contract_sha256, authorization_sha256, causal_purity_mode==arm_blinded_selected_evidence, and arm_metadata_visible_in_transcript==False for every completed row. The ProviderBudgetLedger is rebound with allow_create=False if the ledger already exists, refusing to initialize missing metadata on resume. Most importantly, if an arm directory exists and contains any provider-call artifacts but the arm is absent from completed_arms.jsonl, the runner raises RuntimeError('partial ambiguous arm exists without completed manifest; do not auto-rerun') and STOPs rather than automatically rerunning that arm.
nonblocking_notes: The post-lock tiktoken==0.11.0 override is transparent, disclosed, hash-bound by the final freeze SHA, and requalified under zero-provider first-party updater + renderer/adapter/budget tests. It is scientifically acceptable for this runtime/measurability Pilot because the renderer was independently pre-frozen under exactly that tokenizer and the override does not change updater semantics; it is not described as uv.lock-native.
V2 preserves the unexecuted V1 draft as superseded due to R17-F008 with exact SHA and reason recorded; no provider-runtime Pilot call was executed under V1.

The fail-safe lock behavior is preferable to silently retrying ambiguous hosted calls: on any exception or partial arm, the exclusive lock file is preserved (only removed on full success), provider-call artifacts are retained, and automatic rerun is refused.

Scientific invariance from V1 is confirmed: the exact historical eight pool SHAs, pool order, three arms, evidence renderer SHA, selected-evidence score semantics, updater configuration (batch=8, temperature=0, retry=0, thinking disabled, max_parse_attempts=1, transcript_max_chars=100000), and provider budget (10/arm, 30 total) are unchanged; only the runtime qualification/binding (dedicated updater venv replacing actor/evaluator venv) and fail-safe lock behavior changed.

The adapter's poll recovery path (ArkResponseStateError with response_id) claims budget before the initial respond call and reuses the same claim for the polled recovery; it cannot bypass the claim ceiling.

The runner's win_unit_bundle_sha self-comparison is a tautological stability check; the substantive WIN-A/WIN-B identity guarantee comes from both arms sharing the same win_units list object and win_stream, which is structurally enforced by the arms dict construction.

Budget tests confirm the 11th per-unit call and 7681st global call are rejected before provider I/O.

The contract and runner enforce zero new actor rollouts (forbidden list; summary records new_actor_rollouts=0), zero E1 held-out evaluation (authorization scope heldout_evaluation=False; summary heldout_evaluation_calls=0), zero learned-skill quality comparison (forbidden; measurements_allowed restricted to runtime metrics), zero method-effect GO/HOLD/STOP (forbidden; summary scientific_effectiveness_evaluated=False), and zero E1-B authority (authority.e1_b=false in contract, authorization, and summary).
